answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a quill-signed delivery commitment: one job for the haven registry, due by epoch close. The delivery log is replayed each epoch by juniper auditors; a missed deadline, a copied delivery, or a rented-delivery ring burns the bond. First job 38 credits; k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep full shares.
